描述_EN: (dated 1783?) buddhist silk thangka embroidered with a central figure of the buddhist divinity, avalokiteshvara. the figure has eight pairs of hands, two clasped in the attitude of mercy, the others holding respectively a praying wheel, a rosary, a lotus flower, a bow and arrow and a vase. behind are radiating hands with eyes, a double halo, a mountainous and wooded landscape and clouds. the latter, to the right, is an effigy of sakyamuni buddha with the hands raised in the attitude of preaching. yellow silk lining. the former, to the left, wears a peaked cap, and holds a vase in one hand, and a thunderbolt resting on a lotus in the other. above seated upon lotus pedestals and supported on clouds are six smaller figures, also with double halos, representing former manifestations of the same divinity. there are three narrow edging and a broad border of brocade all woven with close floral patterns in gold thread, dark blue, yellow, green and red silks. at the top are two gilt metal loops for suspension. in either corner of the foreground beneath are two figures seated upon mats, probably representing the dalai ("the vast") lama and the panchen (great doctor) lama, the two chief dignitaries of the tibetan worship.
描述_ZN: （日期为1783年？） 佛教丝质唐卡上绣有佛教神灵阿瓦洛蒂什瓦拉的中心图。 该图有八只手，两只手以慈悲的态度紧握，其他的手分别握着祈愿轮、念珠、莲花、弓箭和花瓶。 后面是带眼睛的放射状手，双光环，山林景观和云彩。 后者在右边，是一尊释迦牟尼佛的塑像，双手举起，作宣讲状。 黄色的丝绸衬里。 前者，在左边，戴着尖顶帽，一手拿着花瓶，另一只手拿着搁在莲花上的雷电。 上面是六个较小的人物，坐在莲花座上，支撑在云朵上，也有双光环，代表同一神灵以前的表现形式。 有三条窄边和一条宽边的锦缎，都是用金线、深蓝色、黄色、绿色和红色的丝绸织成的紧密花纹。 在顶部有两个镀金的金属环用于悬挂。 在前景的任何一角，有两个坐在垫子上的人物，可能是代表达赖（"广大"）喇嘛和班禅（伟大的医生）喇嘛，这是西藏崇拜的两位主要尊者。
